shared_or_similar_visual_information: The lens-shaped region inside both circular outlines. On the left, use the tan lens containing 2, 3, 4, 5 and 11. On the right, use the central unshaded lens labeled 1001 inside both the A and B contours.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The lens lists elements contained in both A and B. Right image: The lens contains elements shared by A and B, with cardinality 1001.
